aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misstates the primary comparison and subgroup structure.
issues: Primary change should be manual check vs auto machine, not unclear baseline vs sample types.
Sample OK and Sample NG are subgroup conditions, not changed factors.
Auto machine subresults lose inherited sample status from merged cells.
Decision row supporting final judgement is not cited.
Outcome domain should identify detection/classification result, not unknown.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to surge test method/equipment: manual baseline vs auto machine.
Use Sample OK and Sample NG as subgroup keys.
Label auto rows as Sample OK | Auto machine and Sample NG | Auto machine.
Add decision row 40 to case evidence and judgement support.
Set outcome to OK/NG detection agreement with manual reference.
